zh: 新增 Oil Find Pro：外置磁盘拔掉后也能搜到，还能搜图片里的文字和画面。可以免费试用 7 天，在设置里开始。
免费版的功能不变，仍然开源。
en: New: Oil Find Pro. External drives stay searchable after you unplug them, and you can search the text and objects in your images. Try it free for 7 days from Settings.
Everything in the free version stays the same and remains open source.
